description: Read the full markdown body of one note by id, or by a title fragment when the id is unknown. Returns id, title, created date and body. When a title fragment matches several notes, returns the candidates instead of a body so one can be chosen.

note_id.description: UUID of the note to read, if known from the conversation. Strongly preferred.

note_name.description: Name/title fragment the user referenced (e.g. 'the Ephesians note'), used when note_id isn't known.

name: read_note
title: Read note
